description: This is a Java test source file for the Reflect utility class in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests that verify the behavior of reflection-based methods, including field retrieval, class hierarchy checks, and collection type recognition, specifically within the context of OpenMRS's object model.

classes.name: ReflectTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the functionality of the Reflect utility class, including field analysis, class hierarchy, and collection type detection.

classes.name: NormalClass
classes.description: A simple class used in tests for hierarchy and type checks.

classes.name: OpenmrsObjectImp
classes.description: A mock implementation class for OpenmrsObject used in reflection tests, with various field types including collections and private fields.

methods.name: xhasField_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenFieldIsDeclaredInParameterizedClassOrSubClass
methods.description: Tests that Reflect.hasField() returns true when the field is declared in the parameterized class or its subclass.

methods.name: xhasField_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenFieldIsNotDeclaredInParameterizedClassOrItsSubClass
methods.description: Tests that Reflect.hasField() returns false for fields not declared in the class hierarchy.

methods.name: getAllFields_shouldReturnAllFieldsIncludePrivateAndSuperClasses
methods.description: Verifies that Reflect.getAllFields() retrieves all fields including private and inherited ones.

methods.name: isCollection_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenFieldClassIsNotACollectionClass
methods.description: Checks that isCollection() returns false for non-collection classes.

methods.name: isCollection_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenFieldClassIsCollectionClass
methods.description: Checks that isCollection() returns true for a collection class.

methods.name: isCollection_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjectIsNotACollection
methods.description: Verifies that isCollection() returns false when the object is not a collection.

methods.name: isCollection_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenObjectIsCollectionClass
methods.description: Verifies that isCollection() returns true when the object is a collection.

methods.name: Reflect_shouldThrowExceptionWhenNullIsPassed
methods.description: Ensures that constructing Reflect with null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: getInheritedFields_shouldReturnOnlyTheSubClassFieldsOfGivenParameterizedClass
methods.description: Tests that getInheritedFields() retrieves only the subclass fields, not superclass fields.

methods.name: isCollectionField_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenFieldIsCollectionAndItsElementTypeIsGivenParameterized
methods.description: Checks if isCollectionField() correctly identifies collection fields with specific element types.

methods.name: isCollectionField_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenFieldIsNotACollection
methods.description: Verifies that isCollectionField() returns false for non-collection fields.

methods.name: isCollectionField_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenFieldIsCollectionAndElementTypeIsOtherThanGiven
methods.description: Ensures isCollectionField() returns false when element types do not match.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenSubClassIsNotAccessibleFromGivenParameterizedClass
methods.description: Tests that isSuperClass() returns false when the subclass is not accessible from the class.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenSubClassIsAccessibleFromGivenParameterizedClass
methods.description: Tests that isSuperClass() returns true for an accessible subclass.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjectIsNotAccessibleFromGivenParameterizedClass
methods.description: Verifies false when object is a class not accessible from the parameterized class.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenObjectIsAccessibleFromGivenParameterizedClass
methods.description: Checks true when object is an accessible subclass instance.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnTrueForAGenericWhoseBoundIsASubclass
methods.description: Verifies that isSuperClass() identifies generic types with bounds that are subclasses.

methods.name: isSuperClass_shouldReturnFalseForAGenericWhoseBoundIsNotASubclass
methods.description: Verifies false for generics whose bounds are not subclasses.
